sloka: ततो द्वादशमे वर्षे शत्रघ्नो रामपालिताम् ।अयोध्यां चकमे गन्तुमल्पभृत्यबलानुगः ।। ७.७१.१ ॥
transliteration: tato dvādaśame varṣe śatraghno rāmapālitām ।ayodhyāṁ cakame gantumalpabhṛtyabalānugaḥ ।। 7.71.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, in the twelfth year, Shatrughna, accompanied by a small retinue of servants and army, desired to go to Ayodhya, which was protected by Rama.
